messages:
maria: quick heads-up — while touching the quickstart I found a couple small but user-visible issues: the hello prompt template uses the old auth flow, the Node example still shows SDK v5 patterns, and the deploy checklist link 404s. starting a thread to coordinate fixes.

sam: ugh. can you paste the broken link + the snippet?

maria: broken link -> https://docs.redwood.ai/quickstart/deploy-checklist (404). the current Node snippet looks like:```js
// old v5 style
const Redwood = require('redwood-sdk')
const client = new Redwood(process.env.OLD_KEY)
const res = await client.generate({ prompt: 'hello' })
```
we should update to the SDK v6/SDK4-style example and show env var RW_API_KEY + brief auth note. also mention the starter repo rename to `starter-apps`.

liam: i'll open a PR for link + node snippet. will also rename repo references. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3128 (WIP).

jess: can you assign me to the starter-apps renames? i can run a grep and replace and update links.

maria: @jess please do. also add a one-line note about local docker env: set RW_API_KEY in .env and expose port 8080.

jess: on it. quick patch plan:
```bash
# update examples
grep -rl "Starterkit" docs/ | xargs sed -i 's/Starterkit/starter-apps/g'
# update deploy checklist link to /quickstart/deploy
```
will include an inline code example for SDK v6 auth.

sam: proposed new Node snippet (short):```js
// SDK v6 example (recommended)
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference'
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_API_KEY })
const chat = await client.chat.create({ model: 'redwood/fast', messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'Hello' }] })
console.log(chat.output)
```

natalie: small FYI — quickstart also refers to a deprecated prompt templates path: `docs/prompts/hello.md` which is now `docs/prompt-templates/hello.md`. liam please sweep that in the same PR.

liam: will do. adding checklist in PR description: update links, bump sdk snippet, add docker env note, rename repo references, fix prompt path.

docs-bot: created issue #456 in redwood/docs: "quickstart: prompt templates + auth snippet + deploy link fixes" (assigned to liam, jess).

jess: pushed commit that renames starter refs and updates deploy link. opening small follow-up PR for snippet content. cc @maria for copy review.

liam: PR #3128 ready for review — includes link fix, prompt path, and repo rename. snippet update is separate PR #3130 by @jess.

maria: reviewing both now. a couple nit comments on the snippet wording (keep auth note short).

jess: addressed Maria's nits, updated snippet to use RW_API_KEY and added a one-liner about secrets management.

deploy-bot: CI: tests/markdown-lint passed for PR #3130. build: succeeded. :white_check_mark:

maria: thanks team — once CI green let's merge both. can we do a staged deploy of docs so the broken link stops returning 404?

liam: yep — will coordinate with infra to push docs site. targeting a small patch release tonight.

maria: perfect. :thumbsup:

sam: quick follow-up: should we add a tiny migration note in the top of quickstart about SDK naming & auth? some users still search for old patterns.

maria: good call. add a short "If you used older examples" callout at top with links to the migration guide.

jess: adding that now. PR #3131 (docs callout) created.

deploy-bot: PR #3128 merged by liam. PR #3130 merged by jess. PR #3131 merged by jess. Docs site deploy started.

maria: verified the updated pages — deploy checklist link works and node snippet updated. marking thread resolved. :white_check_mark:
